description: Returns one page of a previously returned result using page.cursor or page.next_cursor. Costs 0 credits and never calls any upstream API, including on failure. The json_fragment strings concatenate in offset order into the complete original structuredContent JSON, including nested arrays and bulk item errors. The last page has no next_cursor. Cursors are scoped to the same API key and server process. Successful reads extend idle expiry by the configured cache TTL (five minutes by default); eviction or restart can remove a result. An unavailable cursor returns a local error and never starts another paid lookup.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned in page.cursor or page.next_cursor. Retrieval requires the same server process and API key and does not repeat the original lookup.

name: get_cached_result

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned in page.cursor or page.next_cursor. Retrieval requires the same server process and API key and does not repeat the original lookup.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp for idle expiry. Successful page reads extend the cache TTL; eviction or process restart can also remove the result.

json_fragment.description: JSON fragment of the original structuredContent. Fragments concatenate in offset order into the complete JSON, including bulk items and errors.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next get_cached_result page, absent on the last page. Page reads never call the API or consume credits.
